scenes.say: AI links are like gym memberships. They look great until you actually use them.

scenes.sub: with sources · then I clicked every link 🖱️
scenes.say: I asked ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini for laptops under seventy thousand rupees, with sources. Then I clicked every single link.

scenes.label: ChatGPT
scenes.caption: said ₹66k · its own link: ₹78,176
scenes.say: ChatGPT said sixty-six thousand. Its own link? Seventy-eight thousand. Over budget. Thanks, I hate it.

scenes.label: Claude
scenes.caption: top pick: out of stock 🫠
scenes.say: Claude's top pick? Out of stock. Everywhere. To be fair, Claude did tell me to check the prices first.

scenes.label: Gemini
scenes.caption: 3 links · 3 prices · all exact
scenes.say: Gemini: three laptops, three links, three prices. All exactly right. Someone write this down.
So here's the five-second rule: open the link, find the claim, check the date.
